name: Clone Slopes: Box 0 moves north · 1t at (0, 5, 1)
description:
clone must be trapped before you can slide up it

One Up command in a 6×6 room; expect exactly 1 tick after Start.
Player: 1 cell, starting at (0, 5, 1); Box 0: 1 cell, starting at (2, 3, 1); Clone 0: 1 cell, starting at (2, 4, 1). Terrain and fixtures: Limestone, Basalt wall, Yellow clone slope.

Tick 1: Player moves 1 north; Box 0 moves 1 north; Clone 0 moves 1 north.

Coordinates are (x, y, z); north decreases y. Every frame is checked in all four rotations. Unmentioned objects retain their authored positions and states.
